description: Submit a project to the Codenation review queue as a free listing. Nothing is published by this call: a person reviews every submission and may decline it. A free listing links to the project with rel="nofollow". Requires the project's name, its full https:// URL and a contact email for the reviewer; tagline, description and category are optional. Only call this when the user explicitly asks to submit a project they are responsible for. Returns the submission id, or an error result if a field is invalid or the site is already listed. Limited to 5 submissions per hour per client.

category.description: Category slug. Optional, defaults to dev-tools.

description.description: A few sentences about the project. Optional.

email.description: Contact email for the reviewer. Not published.

tagline.description: One line about what it does. Optional.

url.description: Full project URL, starting with https://.

name: submit_tool
title: Submit a tool for review
